title: Match linker definitions and uses
description: You can compare duplicate definitions, missing definitions, and file-local names.

steps.description: Each simulated object records definitions and uses. LIBC supplies a global printf.
link skips LOCAL definitions. It adds global definitions to a table and records duplicate names.
The second pass checks each use against the table. report prints errors or the completed table.
The first scenario duplicates counter. The second omits the object that defines printf.

steps.question: Will two LOCAL counter definitions collide in this linker?
steps.answer: No. The definition pass skips both local entries.

steps.description: The third report succeeds. Its global table contains main, printf, and show.
